llm.summary: This Etsy category lookup skill is mostly purpose-aligned, but it under-discloses that its optional script sends requests and credentials to a remote LinkFox gateway and may save full responses outside the project folder.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Etsy category ID lookup from a synced MCP library, but the bundled script performs a remote POST to a LinkFox gateway with an API key and task metadata, creating a mismatch with the local-retrieval framing.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The activation language is broad but still bounded to Etsy category lookup and related sync/search terms; no prompt override or unrelated instruction behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains SKILL.md, one reference file, and one Python helper script; metadata static scan is clean and no VirusTotal telemetry was supplied.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The helper script reads an API key and session-related environment variables, sends them over the network, and allows the gateway host to be changed by environment variable, which is sensitive for a category lookup helper.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The script writes and caches full API responses locally; its comments promise current-working-directory storage and no /tmp use, but the code can fall back to ~/linkfox or the system temp directory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if you expect purely local lookup. Use it only if you are comfortable providing a LinkFox API key, sending category search queries and session metadata to LinkFox, and having full responses cached on disk. Avoid setting LINKFOX_TOOL_GATEWAY unless you fully trust the destination, and check where the script writes its linkfox output directory.
llm.findings:
[TT3] unexpected: A network call to LinkFox is understandable for the optional API helper, but sending the Authorization header and session metadata to an environment-overridable host is under-scoped and not clearly disclosed.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The artifact repeatedly frames the data source as local MCP-library retrieval, while the script actually uses a remote gateway; the reference file partly discloses the gateway, so this is a disclosure mismatch rather than proof of malicious intent.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The documented storage policy says outputs stay under the current working directory and not /tmp, but the implementation can fall back to home-directory or temp-directory storage.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger scope is broad, but it remains tied to Etsy category search and synced Etsy category data, so this alone would not warrant Review.
